column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus update v262144 trainer battles (bin/trainer/trdata_*.bin)
# note: id = lower-case file stem without 'trdata_'; id_hash = FNV-1a 64 of that stem as stored (VERIFIED for all files).
# note: trname/trtype/loss_msg labels: slots 1/2/7 resolved against the label tables trname/trtype/btl_loss (VERIFIED).
# note: chara_id/model_pack: slot 8 resolved in the resident character table (VERIFIED join; empty if the cache is missing).
# note: seq_intro/seq_lose/seq_f6: slots 4/5/6, files bin/effect/battle/sequence/<id>.wbin; intro/lose roles LIKELY, f6 role UNKNOWN.
# note: pos_*/yaw_deg: slot 9 table, copied to a vec3 + float of the trainer object (VERIFIED copy; meaning battle position LIKELY).
# note: flag_f10: slot 10 read as int and stored as a bool (VERIFIED copy; meaning UNKNOWN).
# note: prize_base: slot 11 int (VERIFIED copy; ASSUMED prize/money base - no consumer found).
# note: item1..4: slots 12..15 int; values 23/24/25 are healing items in item_effects (LIKELY trainer bag items).
# note: ai_*: slots 16..21 bools copied side by side; the AI dispatcher reads 4 adjacent bytes as Basic/Strong/Expert/Allowance (LIKELY mapping; ai_item matches exactly the 10 trainers with items).
# note: restriction_*: single_NNN trainers are the value of key restriction_btl_poke_<species> in event_restriction_battle (VERIFIED join).
